The '''MC30a light cruiser''' was a class of [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] produced at the [[Krinemonen III shipyards]]. It was based off of stolen designs for the [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]], produced by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
